author: Kitsamaru
body: Dear Avicus Network. I got banned for flying? I wasn't flying. nor was I using aimbot. There was a different person using fly hacks. Named RabbitCake777. It probably looked like it because I was lagging very bad. People kept saying I was hacking but I wasn't. If it looked Like iI was hacking I'm sorry I hope this is not permananent. I really like this server. thanks - Cheengu

title: Cheengu banned on 7/10/15?

replies.author: chaibrit1
replies.body:
Hi,

Thank you for sending in an appeal Cheengu. I have decided to appeal your ban due to the lack of evidence supported by the Moderator to support their claim. However, if you are caught hacking once again with sufficient evidence, your chances of being appealed with be at a minimum. Welcome back! 

Regards,

GalaxyBrit
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
